dummy_frequent.description: Always predicts the majority grade - the floor any model must clear.

dummy_stratified.description: Samples grades from the training prevalence - the floor for chance agreement.

logreg.description: Multinomial logistic regression with balanced class weights (linear, fully interpretable).

random_forest.description: Random forest with balanced subsampling (non-linear, robust to feature scale).

hist_gbm.description: Histogram gradient boosting - strong tabular baseline with class weighting.

ordinal_gbm.description: Gradient-boosted regression on the grade plus QWK-optimal cut points (ordinal-aware).

selection_rule: highest patient-grouped cross-validated QWK on the training half; the hold-out set was not consulted for selection
